description: Kubernetes 1.34 is past Google Kubernetes Engine standard support (ended 2027-01-25). Google Kubernetes Engine ended standard support for Kubernetes 1.34 on 2027-01-25; extended support, which applies only if the cluster is on the Extended release channel, runs until 2027-11-25; upgradescope cannot see whether this cluster is enrolled. Extended support costs $4,380 more per cluster per year at list price ($0.60 against $0.10 per cluster-hour, over 8,760 hours; list price as of 2026-10-03, not your bill). It is charged only for clusters on the Extended release channel. Extended support applies only to clusters on the Extended release channel; clusters on other channels are upgraded automatically at the end of standard support. Fix: Upgrade the control plane to a Kubernetes minor that is still in standard support.
